name: workbench
description: Local copy of eascend's Workbench: your current task or plan above the prompt and a side pane. In a project with .claude/plans or .claude/docs it shows For you, Plan, Tracks, Handoffs and Research from those files and the current-status report; elsewhere the plans/ tasks as upstream.

plans_dir.title: Plans folder
plans_dir.description: Folder name for plan files, found at or above the session's folder. One plain name, no slashes.

open_pane.title: Open the pane at start
open_pane.description: on opens the Workbench pane with every session; off leaves it closed until /task pane or the band's arrow.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: on shows the current task and its progress above the prompt; off hides it.

follow_macos.title: Match macOS light and dark
follow_macos.description: on keeps Claude Code's theme on light or dark to match macOS appearance, so skins and the pane redraw for the right background; off leaves the theme alone.
